attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe every woman should be able to access high-quality reproductive health care services, including safe and legal abortion, like the majority of Americans.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion","characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats oppose and will fight to overturn federal and state laws that create barriers to women's reproductive health and rights.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to repeal the Hyde Amendment.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to protect and codify the right to reproductive freedom.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will take action to protect the rights of pregnant women in the workplace.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will require employers to make reasonable accommodations for pregnant and breastfeeding workers and those who have recently given birth.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will enact paid sick days and universal paid family and medical leave.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
